method.grid: 3x3 base plus 3x3 pan; 0.0025 degree square cells; pan offset +0.004 degrees east and north
method.footprint: queryGeometry against a polygon returned from the first base cell
method.payloadPolicy: This report retains aggregate counts only; no parcel IDs, addresses, ownership data, or geometry payloads.

sources.provider: NYC Department of Finance Digital Tax Map
sources.identityCaveat: Keep BBL IDs in a distinct namespace. The current imported NYC route uses SWIS_SBL_ID and emits US-NY IDs; the BBL-to-SWIS_SBL_ID bridge was not verified, so this probe does not claim drop-in identity compatibility.

sources.provider: New York State ITS Geospatial Services / Office of Real Property Tax Services
sources.scope: Annual 2025 parcel data from counties that permitted public sharing; official service description names all five NYC counties/boroughs. It is not complete statewide coverage.
sources.identityAssessment: The local NYC importer reads the 2024 NYS_Tax_Parcels_Public geodatabase layer and copies property SWIS_SBL_ID directly to the unique parcel_nyc_unit.swis_sbl_id key. Existing parcel-nyc route emits US-NY- plus that key. The official MapServer exposes the same string field, and one known existing-style US-NY ID resolved to a NewYork polygon. Thus the native identity/prefix is compatible for that returned record; broader data-vintage continuity has not been established.
sources.performanceCaveat: A single ID query succeeded but took about 13.1 seconds. Batched exact-ID queries and repeated bounded grid queries timed out through the shared adapter; a complete 18-cell sweep and batch round-trip were not verified for this MapServer.
sources.filterRetryAssessment: Layer metadata advertises OBJECTID and SHAPE indexes, but no COUNTY_NAME or SWIS_SBL_ID index. The timed-out sweeps cannot be assumed to improve by adding the five-county filter; no repeated filtered retry was run.
sources.reuseStatus: Service is public; service description states the State provides data as-is. Review publisher terms and operational latency before selecting it as the default source.

sources.provider: Colorado Office of Information Technology GIS
sources.identityCaveat: The Denver import reads `parcel_id` as provided and stores it as varchar(50); its unique index is county_fips plus parcel_id. The official source field is a string of length 50. Keep Denver scoped by countyName=Denver because parcel_id is not globally unique across the statewide layer.
